title: K-th smallest pair distance
pattern: binary search on the answer + two pointers
statement: The distance of a pair (i < j) is |nums[i] − nums[j]|. Return the k-th smallest distance among all pairs. n ≤ 10⁴, values ≤ 10⁶.
complexity: O(n log n + n log W)

solution.explanation: There are 5 × 10⁷ pairs, too many to list. "k-th smallest" → count pairs with distance ≤ m, which is monotone in m, then binary search m. After sorting, the count is a two-pointer sweep: for each i, the j-window with a[i] − a[j] ≤ m only moves right. Parts 1.3 and 2.4 composed.
